best: Every block has a title and a one-line note, and the textbook sub-circuits (cell-tap RC ladder, back-to-back protection FETs, four-switch stage with input/output caps, antenna pi network) are drawn in recognisable form.
worst: USB sheets put tiny parts on a huge page: the bottom third is nearly empty while the PD controller, connector and charger are small and dense, and the charger controller is joined to its four-switch stage only through labels such as SW1, HG1 and BTST1.

Text collisions: C405 and its value sit on top of the P1_LDO_3V3 label and wire, the R110 reference touches the wire in the FET block, the Q103 reference overlaps the IRQ_N transistor, and the 'Cell NTCs' note runs into the TS label stubs.

Many short connections are label-only stubs (gauge SRP/SRN/TS/PACK_SNS, PD controller VBUS/CC pins, the separate EEPROM block, which repeats the PD block's title), so a reviewer has to search net names instead of following wires.
